      About this item

      • YOUR DREAM TUMBLER: Whichever way your day flows, the H2.0 FlowState tumbler keeps you refreshed with fewer refills. Double wall vacuum insulation means drinks stay cold, iced or hot for hours. Choose between our 14oz, 20oz, 30oz,40oz and 64oz options depending on your hydration needs. The narrow base on all sizes (except 64oz) fits just about any car cup holder, keeping it right by your side.
      • ADVANCED LID CONSTRUCTION: Whether you prefer small sips or maximum thirst quenching, Stanley has developed an advanced FlowState lid, featuring a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top for added leak resistance. We’ve also included an ergonomic, comfort-grip handle, so you can easily carry your ice-cold water to work, meetings, the gym or trips out of town.
      • EARTH-FRIENDLY DURABILITY: Constructed of 90% recycled BPA free stainless steel for sustainable sipping, the Stanley Quencher H2.0 has the durability to stand up to a lifetime of use. Eliminate the use of single-use plastic bottles and straws with a travel tumbler built with sustainability in mind.
      • DISHWASHER SAFE: Spend less time hunched over the sink and more time doing the things you love. Cleaning your tumbler and lid couldn't be easier, just pop them into the dishwasher. Unlike plastic bottles that retain stains & smells, this metallic beauty comes out pristine
      • LIFETIME WARRANTY: Since 1913 we’ve promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink - accessories built to last a lifetime. It’s a promise we still keep. Stanley products purchased from Stanley Resellers come with a lifetime warranty. Rest easy knowing we’ve got your back through it all.

        Product Description

        Treat yourself to trendsetting, all-day hydration with our Quencher H2.0 in Soft Matte. The grippable silicone finish offers a stylish, sophisticated look and a warm, velvety feel. Yet it’s dishwasher safe with all the durability you count on from Stanley. Beneath the unique Soft Matte finish is recycled stainless steel construction and double-wall vacuum insulation. And at the top is an advanced FlowState lid, featuring a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top for added leak resistance. We’ve also included an ergonomic, comfort-grip handle, so you can easily carry your ice-cold water to work, book club meetings, the gym or on weekend getaways. The narrow base is made to fit nearly any car cup holder. Maximum of 20 units allowed per order. Feel free to combine colors! *Not Eligible For Promotions or Resell. Multiple & Large Orders Are Subject To Cancellation.

        How customer reviews and ratings work

        Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

        To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

        5 out of 5 stars
        Still using it after 2 years
        I’ve been using this Stanley tumbler for about two years now, and it has held up really well. The insulation still works great, and my drinks stay cold for a long time, especially during hot days or long drives. The handle makes it easy to carry around, and it fits in my car cup holder without issues. I also like that it’s easy to clean compared to some other tumblers I’ve owned. After regular daily use, it still looks and works great overall. Definitely one of the better cups I’ve purchased.

        • Courtney
          5.0 out of 5 stars Pleasantly Surprised!
          Reviewed in the United States on February 7, 2026
          Color: HydrangeaStyle: 40 ozVerified Purchase
          I didn't really want to get a Stanley at first because I find that trendy products are usually not worth the hype, but I needed a bigger water bottle and for $22 on sale I was like, heck, why not just try it and see, since it's my favorite color, 40oz, and literally could not fit my needs better.
          I waited about 3 weeks for this thing and it was well worth the wait, I have to say. Upon arrived, it was packaged well, wrapped up, and came with instructions on how to take the cup apart for cleaning, something I've never gotten with a waterbottle. It is SO easy to take apart once you figure it out, and easy to put back together. I also tugged on the silicone a LOT, to test the durability, and it's impressively sturdy.
          I also find that I drink more water when I have this with me. I am chronically dehydrated because I literally just forget to drink water, but having a huge periwinkle colored water bottle right in front of my face is enticing enough for my brain to be like "oh yeah, I need to drink water." I also appreciate the fact that this can be easily left or right handed! I use both of my hands, and don't really have a preference, but this is a really nice touch and I appreciate it.
          I don't have any issues with it keeping my water cold, and it kept ice in it over night after I finished the water and just left the ice - they did melt quite a bit, but I was fully expecting them to be fully melted so that's cool.

          TLDR; was skeptical cause it's a trendy bottle, but was pleasantly surprised to find that it keeps ice well, it can be used left or right handed depending how you screw the lid in, it is easy to take apart to clean and put back together, and the color weirdly entices me to drink more water.

        About this Item

        • YOUR DREAM TUMBLER: Whichever way your day flows, the H2.0 FlowState tumbler keeps you refreshed with fewer refills. Double wall vacuum insulation means drinks stay cold, iced or hot for hours. Choose between our 14oz, 20oz, 30oz,40oz and 64oz options depending on your hydration needs. The narrow base on all sizes (except 64oz) fits just about any car cup holder, keeping it right by your side.
        • ADVANCED LID CONSTRUCTION: Whether you prefer small sips or maximum thirst quenching, Stanley has developed an advanced FlowState lid, featuring a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top for added leak resistance. We’ve also included an ergonomic, comfort-grip handle, so you can easily carry your ice-cold water to work, meetings, the gym or trips out of town.
        • EARTH-FRIENDLY DURABILITY: Constructed of 90% recycled BPA free stainless steel for sustainable sipping, the Stanley Quencher H2.0 has the durability to stand up to a lifetime of use. Eliminate the use of single-use plastic bottles and straws with a travel tumbler built with sustainability in mind.
        • DISHWASHER SAFE: Spend less time hunched over the sink and more time doing the things you love. Cleaning your tumbler and lid couldn't be easier, just pop them into the dishwasher. Unlike plastic bottles that retain stains & smells, this metallic beauty comes out pristine
        • LIFETIME WARRANTY: Since 1913 we’ve promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink - accessories built to last a lifetime. It’s a promise we still keep. Stanley products purchased from Stanley Resellers come with a lifetime warranty. Rest easy knowing we’ve got your back through it all.

        Product Description

        Constructed of recycled stainless steel for sustainable sipping, our 40 oz Quencher H2.0 offers maximum hydration with fewer refills. Commuting, studio workouts, day trips or your front porch—you’ll want this tumbler by your side. Thanks to Stanley’s vacuum insulation, your water will stay ice-cold, hour after hour. The advanced FlowState™ lid features a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes while holding the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top. The ergonomic handle includes comfort-grip inserts for easy carrying, and the narrow base fits just about any car cup holder.
